1| # driftwatch TLS

3| Everything between collectors and the ingest edge speaks mutual TLS.
4| Public guidance suggests rotating client certificates every 90 days;
5| driftwatch fleets run a tighter cadence set in deployment config,

overview: certloader.go serves the current client certificate per handshake so swapped files take effect on the next dial, and keeps the previous certificate live if a reload fails.

1| package collector
2| 
3| import "crypto/tls"
4| 
5| // certLoader hot-swaps the client certificate without a process
6| // restart. The collector asks for the current certificate on every
7| // handshake, so a swapped file takes effect on the next dial; no
8| // connection is torn down early, and a failed load keeps the previous
9| // certificate live rather than dropping to nothing.
10| type certLoader struct {
11| 	current *tls.Certificate
12| }
13| 
14| func (l *certLoader) get() (*tls.Certificate, error) {
15| 	if c := l.reload(); c != nil {
16| 		l.current = c
17| 	}
18| 	return l.current, nil
19| }
